content.value: An elevator system is designed to lift passengers using a motor-driven hoist. The motor 12 generates a torque $\mathrm { T } _ { \mathrm { m } } { = } 2 0 0 \mathrm { N m }$ The gear system connected to the motor has a gear ratio of $\mathrm { r } = 8 : 1$ , meaning the output gear rotates 8 times slower than the input gear but with 8 times the torque. The hoist drum has a radius $\mathrm { r _ { d } } = 0 . 2 5$ m. Calculate the required output torque, force exerted on the elevator cable, and maximum load mass.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
